sentence: NHS England says the national booking system is open for this winter's flu jab.
Children and pregnant women form the first group, and their vaccinations start on 1 September.

Other groups start on 1 October. These include people aged 65 and over, adults in a clinical risk group, carers, people in close contact with someone who has a weakened immune system, and frontline healthcare workers.
The announcement says the jab can be pre-booked at a community pharmacy.
